title: Passwords
info: A stronger password is long and is not your name or 123456.
Do not tell classmates your password, and do not write it on your notebook cover.
A parent who helps you remember a password is different from posting the password for everyone.

options: A long mix that is not your name
Let a parent help you remember it
Share your password with the whole class

questions.q: Writing a password on a book cover
The same easy password on every account
options: Is risky if one site is copied

questions.q: If a website asks you to send your password to a stranger
Type a bad example password made only of these digits: 123456.
